result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked crosswalks and traffic signals in a mixed-use neighborhood. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two travel lanes and two parking lanes, increasing their exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection crosswalks in the center of the image

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection where cars are parked close to the crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban street with a continuous sidewalk that is partially obstructed by mature trees. While the environment provides basic pedestrian infrastructure, it lacks marked crossings, traffic calming, and adequate separation from parked vehicles, which may limit visibility.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees are planted within the sidewalk area, narrowing the effective clear path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb create a visual barrier between drivers and pedestrians who may attempt to cross the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve safety and visibility during evening hours.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The wide roadway and presence of on-street parking create potential visibility issues and encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.description: There are no visible crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
